command:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$exe = 'C:\Users\james\AppData\Local\Programs\LM Studio\LM Studio.exe'
$manifest = 'C:\Users\james\AppData\Local\Programs\LM Studio\resources\app\package.json'
$lms = 'C:\Users\james\.lmstudio\bin\lms.exe'
$config = 'C:\Users\james\.lmstudio\mcp.json'
$sync = 'C:\Users\james\.lmstudio\.internal\last-synced-mcp-state.json'
$pluginRoot = 'C:\Users\james\.lmstudio\extensions\plugins\mcp'
$configJson = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $config | ConvertFrom-Json
$manifestJson = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $manifest | ConvertFrom-Json
$serverCount = if ($null -eq $configJson.mcpServers) { 0 } else { @($configJson.mcpServers.PSObject.Properties).Count }
$forgeCount = @($configJson.mcpServers.PSObject.Properties | Where-Object Name -in @('forge-conductor','forge-conductor-fallback')).Count
$processes = @(Get-Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.ProcessName -match '^(LM Studio|LM Studio Helper|lms)$' })
$pluginDirectories = if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $pluginRoot) { @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $pluginRoot -Directory | Sort-Object Name | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name) } else { @() }
[ordered]@{
  observed_utc = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToString('o')
  read_only = $true
  lm_studio = [ordered]@{
    executable = $exe
    exists = Test-Path -LiteralPath $exe
    version = (Get-Item -LiteralPath $exe).VersionInfo.ProductVersion
    bytes = (Get-Item -LiteralPath $exe).Length
    sha256 = (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $exe).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
    manifest = $manifest
    manifest_name = $manifestJson.name
    manifest_version = $manifestJson.version
    manifest_sha256 = (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $manifest).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
  }
  cli = [ordered]@{
    executable = $lms
    exists = Test-Path -LiteralPath $lms
    sha256 = (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $lms).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
  }
  configuration = [ordered]@{
    path = $config
    valid_json = $true
    bytes = (Get-Item -LiteralPath $config).Length
    sha256 = (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $config).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
    mcp_server_count = $serverCount
    forge_server_count = $forgeCount
    reparse_point = [bool]((Get-Item -LiteralPath $config).Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint)
    synchronization_state_path = $sync
    synchronization_state_exists = Test-Path -LiteralPath $sync
    plugin_root = $pluginRoot
    plugin_directories = $pluginDirectories
  }
  runtime = [ordered]@{
    lm_studio_process_count = $processes.Count
    supported_launch_executable = $exe
    url_protocol_registered = Test-Path -LiteralPath 'Registry::HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Classes\lmstudio'
    supported_hot_reload_command_observed = $false
    gui_automation_used = $false
  }
} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8
